strategy.title: What Makes Nature So Fascinating?
strategy.hook: There is more to Nature than most people realize.

story_structure.opening: Introduce a surprising fact about Nature.
story_structure.escalation: Break Nature into three clear visual moments.
story_structure.takeaway: Finish with one memorable perspective the audience can share.

strategy.audience: Curious learners and visual education audiences.
